messages:
olivia: Heads-up: PR #10110 updates 'api-keys.md' with a usage example. CI preview flagged a broken link and the snippet includes a key-like string. We need security + legal quick review before merge.

ci-bot: Docs preview for PR 10110: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/10110 — build: passed, link-check: failed (1 broken link). Files changed: docs/security/api-keys.md

rahul: I'll replace the inline-looking key and add a short Secret Manager example. Quick preference check: use GENERIC_API_KEY or <REDACTED_KEY>?

sec-bot: Policy note: do not include any realistic token prefixes. Use PLACEHOLDER_SECRET or show secret manager client code. Creating ticket sec-229 for this PR.

olivia: Original problematic snippet:
```bash
# BAD: looks like a real key
export REDWOOD_KEY=redwood_live_12345abcd
```

olivia: Proposed replacement (in branch 10110-clean):
```js
// GOOD: load from Secret Manager or CI-injected env
const key = await secretManager.accessSecretVersion('projects/x/secrets/REDWOOD_KEY/versions/latest');
// or process.env.REDWOOD_KEY injected at runtime
```

rahul: Pushed the change and fixed the broken anchor link that CI flagged. Added a short note at the top of the page: "Do not paste real keys; use Secret Manager or CI-injected environment variables."

legal: Quick legal check: avoid showing real-looking prefixes like redwood_live_. If you replace with GENERIC_KEY or PLACEHOLDER_SECRET we're fine. No legal/regulatory flags.

maya: I updated the contributor guide link in the PR and added a one-line changelog entry. Also ran a local link-check before pushing.

ci-bot: Preview updated: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/10110 — build: succeeded, link-check: passed.

olivia: Requesting merge in today's docs merge window (3:00–4:00pm PT). I can merge at ~3:10pm PT if everyone signs off.

rahul: Security: sec-229 approved after the snippet swap and the addition of the secret-manager example.

legal: Approved.

maya: All good from docs maintenance side.

olivia: Merged at 3:12pm PT. Closing sec-229 and adding a short example to the contributor guide about placeholders and secret-manager patterns. Thanks all!
